name: Episode Title Fixer
description: Replaces placeholder episode titles like "Afsnit 11" or "Episode 11" with the original title.
overview: When TMDb or TheTVDB has no episode title in your language, it returns a placeholder like "Afsnit 11". This plugin swaps it for the original title and locks it.

versions.changelog:
- First version
- Fixes placeholder titles automatically when episodes are added or refreshed
- Scheduled task to fix the whole library
- Settings page in English and Danish
